meta.description: AMONEDACION ARGENTINA - NFT digital collection of Argentine coins
meta.keywords: NFT, Argentine coins, numismatics, digital collection, blockchain

inicio.p-1: We invite you to explore the historical and cultural richness of Argentine coins through our digital platform.
inicio.nft-p-1: NFT stands for "Non-Fungible Token". It's a special type of unique digital asset that represents ownership or authenticity of a digital item, such as art, music, collectibles, and more, recorded on a blockchain.
inicio.rareza-p-1: Each NFT coin in the collection is classified according to its rarity, reflecting its availability and relative value within the set. These rarity grades are directly related to the number of physical specimens documented in my Argentine coin catalog, thus bridging traditional and digital collecting.
inicio.rareza-p-2: In numismatics, rarity indicates the difficulty of obtaining a piece, beyond its price, date, or condition. This classification also applies in the digital realm: greater rarity means lower availability of NFTs and generally a higher challenge to acquire them.
inicio.rareza-r1:
🟢 R1 (Common) – 1,000 units
Ideal for collectors taking their first steps into the world of numismatic NFTs.
inicio.rareza-r2:
🔵 R2 (Scarce) – 400 units
Lower mintage, higher exclusivity. A perfect choice for those seeking more limited pieces.
inicio.rareza-r3:
🟠 R3 (Rare) – 100 units
More scarce, designed for those who value uniqueness.
inicio.rareza-r4:
🔴 R4 (Very rare) – 30 units (Coming soon)
Exclusive coins with very high collector value.
inicio.rareza-r5:
⚫ R5 (Extremely rare) – 5 units (Coming soon)
The highest level of scarcity. Only for the most demanding collectors.
